• NorthEast United FC vs Bengaluru FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 19 || 30-Oct-2026 || English ||
Late drama at the top of the table! Watch the big moments as NorthEast United FC and Bengaluru FC drew 1-1 in Guwahati to keep both their unbeaten runs going in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Jithin M.S. put the Highlanders ahead early from Ethyan González’s pass. Bengaluru pushed for most of the night with 64% of the ball and 18 shots. In the third minute of stoppage time, Sunil Chhetri found Vinith Venkatesh, who levelled the score.
